rationale: Independent reading: held EO 13422 (72 FR 2763, Jan. 18, 2007) amends EO 12866 (guidance documents, Regulatory Policy Officers); no own term. Held EO 13497 (74 FR 6113, Jan. 30, 2009) sec. 1: 'Executive Order 13258 ... and Executive Order 13422 of January 18, 2007 ... are revoked'; sec. 2 rescission of implementing guidance; no savings clause. Express by-number whole revocation; independent status NO, agrees. Refutation: ACT scope 'partial' reflects the two-order sentence, not a limit on EO 13422. D6: EO 13777 and EO 14215 amend or cite EO 12866 and do not restore EO 13422 text; EO 14219 sec. 6(e) (Feb. 19, 2025) defines 'Regulation' to include any 'guidance document' 'as defined in Executive Order 13422', a borrowed definition inside a new order that does not revive EO 13422's commands (a definition-by-reference to a revoked order, noted). No amendment of 13422 between 2007 and 2009; nothing removed or ignored. Accept.
